title: BOEING_2022_10K — 供应商部件交付风险与供应链中断的泛化表述（p10）
key_points: Boeing 声明：若供应商无法以达成目标所需的成本与速率及时交付部件，公司可能无法满足交付计划。
供应商部件延迟或缺陷、未达成内部绩效计划、未取得所需监管批准，可能导致额外的脱序作业（out-of-sequence work）与生产成本上升。
Boeing 及其供应商正因 COVID-19 的持续影响、全球供应链约束与劳动力不稳定而经历供应链中断，并承受通胀压力。
Boeing 称这些因素降低了整体生产率并对财务表现造成不利影响。
该段落未点名任何具体供应商（未出现 Spirit AeroSystems、CFM、GE、Safran 等名称）。
raw_excerpt: …if our suppliers cannot timely deliver components to us at the cost and rates necessary to achieve our targets, we may be unable to meet delivery schedules… Operational issues, including delays or defects in supplier components, failure to meet internal performance plans, or delays or failures to achieve required regulatory approval, could result in additional out-of-sequence work and increased production costs… We and our suppliers are experiencing supply chain disruptions as a result of the lingering impacts of COVID-19, global supply chain constraints, and labor instability. We and our suppliers are also experiencing inflationary pressures. … These factors have reduced overall productivity and adversely impacted our financial [performance].

title: BOEING_2022_10K — 737-7 / 737-10 的 FAA 取证门槛、ACSAA §116 修订与库存/订单敞口（p34、p9、p36）
key_points: 737-7 与 737-10 两个机型当时正在接受 FAA 型号合格证审定。
《2023 年综合拨款法》修订了 ACSAA 第 116 条：2020 年 12 月 27 日之前提交的原始或修订型号合格证申请（含 737-7 与 737-10）不再受第 116 条机组告警系统规格约束。
自 FAA 颁发 737-10 型号合格证满一年起，任何新的 737 MAX 飞机必须包含特定安全增强项才能获得 FAA 原始适航证；这些增强项的充分性由 FAA 判定。
Boeing 预期 737-7 于 2023 年开始 FAA 取证试飞；737-10 于 2023 年开始 FAA 取证试飞、2024 年首次交付。
Boeing 声明：若取证延迟或安全增强项整合延迟，未来收入、现金流与经营业绩可能受到不利影响。
10-K 的 Program Development 图表列出 737-7 计划初始交付年份为 2023、737-10 为 2024。
Boeing 指出 777X、737-7、737-10 等新机型与衍生机型的推出，在满足开发、测试、取证与生产进度方面风险上升，原因包括 737 MAX 事故后全球对开发机型的监管审查加强。
raw_excerpt: The 737-7 and 737-10 models are currently going through FAA certification. The Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 amended Section 116 of the ACSAA, such that applications for original or amended type certifications that were submitted to the FAA prior to December 27, 2020, including those of the 737-7 and 737-10, are no longer subject to the crew alerting specifications of Section 116. Additionally, beginning one year after the FAA issues the type certificate for the 737-10, any new 737 MAX aircraft must include certain safety enhancements… the sufficiency of these enhancements will be determined by the FAA. … the 737-7 to begin FAA certification flight testing in 2023, and the 737-10 to begin FAA certification flight testing in 2023 with first delivery in 2024. At December 31, 2022, we had 27 737-7 and 3 737-10 aircraft in inventory and 236 737-7 and 720 737-10 aircraft in backlog and have delivered a total of 1,033 737 MAX aircraft. If we experience delays in achieving certification and/or incorporating safety enhancements, future revenues, cash flows and results of operations could be adversely impacted.

title: BOEING_2022_10K — 787 返工：交付暂停、5 架/月路径与 28 亿美元异常成本估算（p35、p81、p9）
key_points: 787 交付于 2021 年 5 月至 2022 年 8 月期间暂停；Boeing 于 2022 年 7 月 28 日获得 FAA 恢复交付授权，8 月恢复交付。
Boeing 当时以低速率生产，预期 2023 年逐步恢复至每月 5 架。
Boeing 持续对已建造与已入库飞机进行检查与返工；截至 2022 年 12 月 31 日库存约 100 架（2021 年约 110 架），其中大部分预期在 2024 年底前交付。
截至 2022 年 12 月 31 日累计已计入的异常成本为 17 亿美元。
2022 年第四季度将异常生产成本总估算上调至 28 亿美元，其中大部分将在 2023 年底前发生；而 2021 年 12 月 31 日时的累计预期约为 20 亿美元。
该上调「主要由于 2022 年第四季度决定因供应链约束与检查返工成本上升而放缓近期生产」。
787 项目 2022 年与 2021 年分别计入异常生产成本 12.40 亿美元与 4.68 亿美元。
2021 年第四季度因返工导致交付延迟超出预期，787 项目计入 34.60 亿美元 reach-forward 损失。
787 交付暂停的原因是生产质量问题，包括供应链中的质量问题。
raw_excerpt: We received FAA authorization to resume delivery on July 28, 2022 and deliveries resumed in August. During 2022, we delivered 31 aircraft to customers. We continue to conduct inspections and rework on undelivered aircraft. … At December 31, 2022, and 2021, we had approximately 100 and 110 aircraft in inventory. … We are currently producing at low rates and expect to gradually return to 5 per month in 2023. … Cumulative abnormal costs recorded through December 31, 2022 totaled $1.7 billion. During the fourth quarter of 2022 we adjusted the total estimate of abnormal production costs up to $2.8 billion with most being incurred by the end of 2023. At December 31, 2021, we were expecting to incur approximately $2 billion of abnormal production costs on a cumulative basis. The increase was primarily driven by a decision in the fourth quarter of 2022 to slow down near-term production due to supply chain constraints and increased inspection and rework costs.

title: BOEING_2022_10K — Note 7 / 777X 生产暂停与 787 递延成本
key_points: 2022 年 4 月公司决定在 2022 与 2023 年暂停 777X-9 生产，暂停期间相关异常生产成本即期费用化。
2022 年因 777X-9 生产暂停发生异常生产成本 3.25 亿美元。
777X 项目 2022 年末毛利率接近盈亏平衡。
2022 年末 787 递延生产成本 126.89 亿美元（2021 年末 116.93 亿美元），供应商预付款 18.31 亿美元。
